brief: Retrieve the corrected payment register from Finance. Mira manages payroll corrections. Investigate memorable names and numbers, then recover access with a small candidate pool.

facts.label: Staff profile
facts.note: Her profile links a pet album and an old account-recovery example. 'I make sure your disappointment arrives on payday.'

facts.label: Graduation record
facts.note: She calls 2002 her lucky number and says she still uses the full year for personal accounts.

facts.label: Pet album
facts.note: 'The payroll portal is named after Luna. Name first, lucky year next. Capital L; she is management.'

facts.label: Recovery example
facts.note: The form uses an old year, but shows the capitalized name, full year and exclamation-mark suffix. It links a follow-up support message.

facts.label: Support follow-up
facts.note: She confirms that the obsolete year was replaced by her graduation year. 'The exclamation mark is the only enthusiasm left in this department.'

facts.label: Office raffle
facts.note: A joke about missing bonuses. No evidence that this number is used in her accounts.

solution.explanation: Mira uses her current cat Luna, capital L, followed by the full graduation year 2002. The recovery example and support message establish the ! suffix. Combine Luna and 2002 with the suffix rule, or include ! as a fragment.
